title: Connection Hygiene
summary: Connection hygiene means every session is identifiable, bounded, and disposable. max_connections is a hard capacity envelope, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout releases forgotten transactions, statement_timeout caps runaway work, and application_name lets responders tie sessions to services.
learning_objectives: Explain the operational purpose of Connection Hygiene.
Collect PostgreSQL evidence before proposing remediation.
Describe verification and rollback for the administrative action.
reflection_prompts: What evidence would you attach to an incident review?
Which part of the remediation has the largest operational blast radius?
